implementationReviewChecklist: Give each of the ten cold launches an identifiable start/end, asserted usable login/home control, and a declared fixed observation interval. Process existence or simctl launch return alone is not the planned success condition.
The final normal SpringBoard tap must target the same installed bytes last verified; screenshots of an icon asset or XCTest launch alone cannot replace that observation.
Preserve the production data container during replacement; restrict synthetic reset/deletion and Keychain test credentials to a UUID/account-specific scope.

Include new AppIcon, signing/project settings, drivers and XCTest sources in run inputs, and validate loaded test binary provenance and installed app bytes. Do not reuse the prior signed experiment artifact or only compare source hashes.
Use actual Keychain and unchanged negative assertions. Record account-service mocks as mocks; do not replace the failed Keychain branch with a stub or plaintext.

Keep maximum-text final-line reachability and genuine motion/reduced-motion temporal assertions meaningful; do not weaken tolerances, fake settings, reuse stale test bundles or mark cropped screenshot sweeps complete.
Final independent evidence review must state exact sampled/full screenshot scope and preserve any remaining historical 53-state or remote/device gaps.
